title: Display and photo choices at the quilt show
titleZh: 拼布被展的展示與照片選擇

documents.title: Display, credit and access rules
documents.text:
Display quilts on padded tables or compatible rails. After check-in, two trained handlers must move a quilt to another display surface; after opening, close the aisle first.

Change printed hall credit only at the maker's written request. If withdrawn, cover the name but keep the title and number visible until the new card is ready.

Gallery photos need online approval and must show no names or initials; caption by entry number. Judges may see approved signed photos in the private review folder. Desk visitors may see live gallery images, not judging photos.

For pickup by a substitute, require the original message for that entry and written approval naming the collector from its maker. If either is missing, hold the quilt and check with the maker.
documents.textZh:
拼布被用有軟墊的桌子或規格相符的橫桿展示。報到後，作品若要移到另一展示台面，須有兩名受過訓練的搬運人員；開館後還須先封閉走道。

展卡印出後，只有製作者書面提出要求才能更改署名。若撤回署名，請遮住姓名，但在新卡備妥前保留作品名稱與編號可見。

圖庫照片須經網路刊登授權，不得顯示姓名或姓名縮寫，圖說用參展編號。評審可在非公開的評審資料夾查看經授權的署名照。服務台可向訪客展示已上線的圖庫照片，不可展示評審照片。

代領時，須出示該作品的原始領件訊息及製作者指名代領人的書面同意。缺一就保留作品，並向製作者確認。

documents.title: Intake and permissions
documents.text:
17, Harbor Steps, by Tessa King: three-centimeter sleeve. No hall name credit. Online photos approved, but a new full view requires a paper screen hiding the initials without touching the quilt.

42, Orchard Road, by Lin Bell: six-centimeter sleeve. No online photos, even anonymous ones. Lin emailed at nine to remove her printed hall credit. At nine fifteen a volunteer asked to add Tessa's name; Tessa herself has not requested this.

Both makers approved judging photos. The signed photo of 17 is in the event folder, which judges cannot access.
documents.textZh:
17 號《港口階梯》，泰莎・金製作，布套開口三公分。不同意展卡署名。同意線上刊登照片，但重拍全幅照須用紙片擋住姓名縮寫，且紙片不可接觸作品。

42 號《果園路》，琳・貝爾製作，布套開口六公分。即使匿名也不得在線上刊登照片。琳九點寄電郵要求移除已印在展卡上的署名。九點十五分有志工要求加上泰莎的名字，但泰莎本人未提出要求。

兩位都同意將照片用於評審。17 號的署名照在活動資料夾，評審無法存取。

documents.title: Setup, gallery and pickup notes
documents.text:
17 is checked in on the padded window table. The rail needs a sleeve at least five centimeters wide. A second padded table is ready at eleven. Before eleven twenty, two trained handlers are available only at ten forty and eleven ten. The hall opens at eleven; the aisle cannot close before eleven fifteen.

The paper screen arrives at eleven. The photographer leaves at eleven five. The center close-up of 17 is live.

Ellis brings Lin's written approval naming Ellis, but the pickup message is for 17. Robin brings the original message for 17 and Tessa's email naming Robin.
documents.textZh:
17 號已報到，放在窗邊的軟墊桌上。橫桿要求布套開口至少五公分。第二張軟墊桌十一點備妥。十一點二十分前，兩名受過訓練的搬運人員只在十點四十分及十一點十分有空。展場十一點開放，走道最快十一點十五分才能封閉。

紙片十一點送到，攝影人員十一點零五分離開。17 號中央特寫已在線上刊登。

艾利斯帶了琳指名他代領的書面同意，但領件訊息是 17 號的。羅賓帶了 17 號的原始訊息，以及泰莎指名他代領的電郵。
